scope: Canonical host Tier-0 parameter-authoring boundary and public startup-pin projection. No authenticated birth coordination, physical repair or deployment qualification claim.

repository_reproducer.case: Existing malformed or old-schema context refuses authoring and retains exact bytes; valid independent context survives parameter repair.

causal_profile.existing_source: Undecodable public context; the authoring request supplies parameters only.
causal_profile.old_result: Canonical writer catches context decoding failure and replaces the source with defaults.
causal_profile.required_result: Refuse authoring and retain the exact original bytes; never infer legacy admission from an unavailable context.
causal_profile.old_to_new_envelope_mapping: Same authoring input and resource profiles; publication adds bounded public-file locking, descriptor observation, fsync, atomic replacement and exact readback. Runtime resource envelopes and provider topology are unchanged.

replacement.generated_config_binding: Domain-separated parameter digest plus canonical public registration-pin digest; format-three artifacts attest both, historical format-two reads assert no pin coverage.
